    What the check means

    • VerifiedYour name and PAN agree across your documents.
    • MismatchA name, PAN or salary amount differs between your documents. Our team will review it with you.
    • IncompleteWe still need your ID card or your salary slip.
    • Not applicableOnly a bank statement has been uploaded.
